title: How FOG delivers: survey, itemised quote with a ceiling, commissioning report

scenes.headline: The paper trail your procurement team wants.
scenes.voice: Procurement teams and project sponsors need more than a promise. They need a paper trail they can check at every stage of the project.

scenes.headline: From survey to signed commissioning.
scenes.voice: Every FOG Technologies Nexus project starts with a site survey. The quotation is itemised, showing what is firm, what is provisional, and the ceiling. Every installation is tested, and handed over with a signed commissioning report.

scenes.headline: Records that survive staff changes.
scenes.voice: You keep the as-built drawings, the test results and the commissioning sign-off, long after the people who ran the project have moved on.

scenes.headline: Request an executive briefing
scenes.voice: Request an executive briefing on how we would deliver your next project. Write to CEO at fogtechnexus.space.
